_NOTE: Tier 3 PR A — comorbidity interaction map. When a user has BOTH conditions in a pair, the listed exercise patterns are flagged at .serious severity (modal acknowledgement gate) — even if neither condition alone would block the exercise. Sources cited per entry. v1 is dev-curated from APTA + Goodman & Snyder published guidelines; PT review is recommended but not required for these high-evidence common pairs.

aliases._NOTE: Maps user-entered free-text to canonical condition IDs used in interactions[]. Lowercase keys; matches via exact key OR substring containment AFTER lowercasing + collapsing whitespace to underscores.

interactions.source: APTA fall-prevention guidelines + WHO Decade of Healthy Ageing
interactions.note: Unsupported balance work raises fall risk above what bone density tolerates. Either condition alone is .caution; combined → .serious.

interactions.source: ADA + American Heart Association joint statement on diabetic foot care
interactions.note: Plantar / weight-bearing impact work amplifies foot-injury risk in diabetic PVD. Inspection without sensation = unsafe.
Neuropathy + glycemic-related vascular fragility → undetected micro-trauma. Pool, recumbent, or seated alternatives required.
Valsalva-risk exercises spike systolic load. Both conditions independently are .caution; combined needs medical clearance.

interactions.source: Goodman & Snyder, Differential Diagnosis 6e — chapter on tendon/ligament integrity under steroids
interactions.note: Long-term steroids weaken tendon/ligament; combined with acute injury, heavy or eccentric loading risks rupture.
Any fall on anticoagulants risks intracranial / retroperitoneal bleed. Each alone is .caution; pair upgrades.

interactions.source: AACVPR cardiac rehab guidelines — postsurgical reentry protocols
interactions.note: Post-surgical recovery + cardiac history requires HR / RPE monitoring and graded reentry. Skip high-intensity until cleared.

interactions.source: NOF Clinician's Guide to Prevention and Treatment of Osteoporosis
interactions.note: Reduced bone density + post-op tissue healing = compounded fracture risk. Avoid loaded flexion / impact entirely until surgeon clears.

interactions.source: ACR/EULAR exercise recommendations for inflammatory arthritis
interactions.note: RA flare + chronic steroid use = compromised tendon integrity. Use lighter loading, slower tempo.
Anticoagulants + recent soft-tissue injury = continued bleeding risk. Avoid impact / aggressive loading until cleared.
